implementation_policy: Reuse original RiskProbability/FaultNode/JointState contracts, scope validators and the separately installed owner Boolean engine. This package maps exact periods, common survival conditioning, contexts, source receipts and lineage; no new Boolean solver is implemented.
native_backend: existing owner default enumerate; at most 20 distinct events with an explicit state budget

primary_data.joint_scenarios: Two explicitly declared feasible extreme-overlap joint distributions; no observed inter-component dependence is inferred.

limitations: A period Boolean AND does not establish temporal coincidence or failure sequence.
No repair, repeated failures, annual frequency, containment-loss conversion or field applicability is inferred.
Point-fit specimen scatter is not parameter uncertainty; common conditioning and observed joint dependence remain separate research requirements.
Code scope extension does not change the state of risk.common_cause from partial.
